answer: For a poll on whether trails should wander past the juniper grove, the server rejects ballots without a yes or no choice and randomly assigns valid ballots to 10 buckets. The kernel of the rule is that the proposal passes only with a yes majority in every bucket. If each bucket has 100 honest no votes, an attacker needs at least 1,010 yes ballots, costing submission effort. Fake ballots can still prevail, and one unrepresentative bucket can block a proposal.
